caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a human figure standing on a rectangular, dark gray pedestal. The figure is dressed in a blue jacket with yellow buttons, a red vest or shirt underneath, light gray or pale blue trousers, and black shoes. The figure has gray sideburns and is wearing a black top hat. The figure is holding a sextant, an instrument used in navigation, in both hands and appears to be looking through it. The drawing is rendered in muted, naturalistic colors, with minimal shading, and is positioned against a plain, light beige background. The marks and lines are clean and well-defined, with all attention focused on the statue and its features.
title: The Navigator
